title: ZEROFIRM TWTC: Advanced Teleport Tools
features:
ZERØFIRM TWTC
It is an advanced universal teleport tool.
It's always free and you don't need a key.

Feature :

Object Scan Teleport: Scans the map environment to locate objects (like coins or chests). Selecting an object via Pick 3D and pressing Move Obj will instantly teleport your player directly to that nearest scanned item. (Items assigned random names may not be detected perfectly, which could lead to bugs.)

Universal Auto Scan & Add: Automatically detects and adds targeted interactive items or stages across the world into your teleport list using custom prefixes or range limits.

Flexible Movement Modes: Save custom waypoints or jump points and choose how your player moves to each location via instant Teleport, Walking, or smooth Tween navigation.

Player & Target Tracking: Select other players or targets to follow, attach to, or instant-teleport 1X TP straight to their position.

Automation & Loop Controls: Execute continuous navigation or farming routines automatically using Start Loop, Loop Once, or Stop All.

Speed Boost & Auto-Respawn: Toggle character speed modifications with adjustable values and manage respawn options.

Custom Keybind Remapping: Assign fast hotkeys (using `Alt + [Key]`) for saving locations, toggling loops, boosting speed, or hiding the UI.

Data Preset Export/Import: Easily save, export, or share your custom route coordinates and settings using data codes.
